_comment: Copy to config/collector.json (gitignored) and edit the paths.
The database MUST NOT live on the system drive (C:\ on most machines):
surviving a Windows reset is the point of this project, and
openDatabase() refuses a path there and throws.
databasePath   the live database. If its folder is synced by a cloud
client, remember a WAL database is three files that can
be uploaded at three different instants -- so the synced
copy of THIS file is not a reliable restore source.
backupPath     a consistent single-file copy, written with SQLite's
backup() API after every ingest. Restore from THIS one.
The recovery kit also writes its bundle and local-files
copy into this folder.
scratchDir     working space, kept OUTSIDE any synced folder: the
recovery kit puts a plaintext copy of .env.local in its
recovery folder unless secretsDir says otherwise.
secretsDir     optional: where the recovery kit copies .env.local and
android/keystore.properties, and where npm run drill
looks for them. Defaults to <scratchDir>\recovery. Must
be off the system drive and NOT synced to a cloud.
samplerLogDir  where the Windows sampler appends its JSONL between
ingests. Also off the system drive: until the next ingest
it is the only copy of that day's screen time.
deviceLabel    what this machine is called in the dashboard; its URL
slug is derived from it ("My Laptop" -> /windows/my-laptop).
Optional, for a laptop that runs Screen Time Native (the standalone
Windows app) instead of this project's sampler -- run only ONE sampler:
nativeDatabasePath  that app's live database, e.g.
D:\PersistentData\screen-time-native\live\screen-time.db.
Set, and the ingest copies the laptop's screen time
from there instead of reading samplerLogDir.
nativeFrom          the seam, a LOCAL HOUR EDGE such as
2026-10-03T01:00:00+06:00: rows from then on come
from Screen Time Native, earlier rows stay as they are.
nativeSamplerDir    where its heartbeat is; defaults to
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Screen Time Native\sampler.
Switching: install-sampler.ps1 -IngestOnly stops this project's sampler
cleanly and keeps the hourly ingest; run npm run ingest once more, then
add the keys above.
